ja: 兄に夕食に誘われたとき、私はもう別の予定を入れてしまっていた。
en: When my brother invited me to dinner, I'd already made other plans.
alternatives: I had already made other plans when my brother invited me to dinner.
By the time my brother asked me to dinner, I'd already made other plans.
point: 誘われた時点より前の予定は had made の過去完了

ja: 土曜のバーベキュー、私たち何時に集合することになったんだっけ？
en: What time did we decide to meet for Saturday's barbecue?
alternatives: What time did we agree to meet for Saturday's barbecue?
When did we decide to meet for the barbecue on Saturday?
point: What time を文頭に置き、後ろは did we decide の疑問文の語順

ja: あのとき飛行機を予約しておけば、今ごろ私たちは沖縄のビーチでのんびりしているのにね。
en: If we'd booked the flight back then, we'd be relaxing on a beach in Okinawa right now.
alternatives: If we had booked that flight, we'd be on a beach in Okinawa now.
If we'd booked the flight when we had the chance, we'd be lounging on a beach in Okinawa right now.
point: 過去の条件と今の結果は if 節が過去完了、主節が would be

ja: 都合が悪いのは週末全部じゃなくて、日曜の朝だけなんだ。
en: It's only Sunday morning that doesn't work for me, not the whole weekend.
alternatives: What doesn't work for me is just Sunday morning, not the whole weekend.
It's just Sunday morning that's bad for me, not the whole weekend.
point: 強調したい「日曜の朝」を It's と that で挟む

ja: ごめん、疲れてるからパーティーに行けないよ。
en: Sorry, I can't go to the party. I'm tired.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm too tired to go to the party.
Sorry, I can't come to the party. I'm tired.
point: 「行けない」は can't go、理由は短く別の文で足せる

ja: 幹事に頼んで、来週の同窓会の開始を一時間遅らせてもらったよ。
en: I got the organizer to push the start of next week's reunion back an hour.
alternatives: I had the organizer push back the start of next week's reunion by an hour.
I asked the organizer to move next week's reunion an hour later, and they did.
point: get 人 to do と have 人 do、to の有無に注意

ja: キャンセルするなら、せめて前の日に教えてくれればよかったのに。
en: If you were going to cancel, you should have at least told me the day before.
alternatives: You could have at least let me know the day before if you were going to cancel.
If you had to cancel, you should have at least told me a day earlier.
point: 「〜すればよかったのに」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 日曜のピクニックは雨のせいで来週に延期されたよ。
en: Sunday's picnic has been postponed until next week because of the rain.
alternatives: Sunday's picnic was put off until next week because of the rain.
Because of the rain, Sunday's picnic has been pushed back to next week.
point: ピクニックが主語なので has been postponed の受け身

ja: 急で悪いんだけど、土曜のランチを日曜にずらせないかなと思ってて。
en: Sorry for the short notice, but I was wondering if we could move Saturday's lunch to Sunday instead.
alternatives: Sorry it's so last minute, but would it be possible for us to move Saturday's lunch to Sunday?
Sorry for the late notice, but I was hoping we could push Saturday's lunch back to Sunday.
point: 柔らかい頼み方は I was wondering if we could
